note: Executable parser slice expanded through civilization vocabulary, audited Yona vocabulary, and residual ordinary combat/injury/sensory-state vocabulary.

entries.ordinary_language_note: Canonical Confidence is normalized from Zero (complete rejection) through «ConfidenceUnit» @ (complete confidence/certainty). World/mind models may compute confidence differently internally but expose this normalized ordered scale.
Density(entity) returns the entity's density. Density(distribution,region) returns the local density of that Distribution over the supplied Region; this replaces the specialized LocalDensity root.

Typed equality. The generic same-type frame yields Proposition; the more specific Entity frame means identity equality and yields StateProposition, replacing the former Same relation while preserving state typing for identity constraints.

Change(theme,attribute,target) sets an attribute to an exact target. The constraint frame describes a change event by a proposition over event-local BeforeValue/AfterValue snapshots, allowing directional change such as growth without a separate process root.

Existence state over entities and other semantic values such as Sign tokens. Creating/writing a Sign is represented as agentive Cause of Begin Exist for that Sign; the state then persists unless separately ended.

Persistent integrity/completeness state relative to a recognized structural profile. Ending Whole is the general structural-loss transition used for severing/breaking apart when no narrower world model is required.
Persistent spatial-location state. Teleportation is represented as a discontinuous At-state boundary transition (End At source + Begin At goal) rather than ordinary Move along a Path.

Concrete Event/TimePoint frames express objective temporal ordering. Pattern/state overloads are contextual occurrence/holding relations: Before(EventSpec,T) means a matching occurrence is complete before T; Before(T,EventSpec) means a matching occurrence begins after T; the analogous StateProposition frames mean the state held before or will hold after T. The EventSpec+TimeInterval frame preserves an explicitly supplied past reference/scope.
Persistent capability relation. Because capability is a state, Begin Can(agent,event) is the acquisition-of-skill form used when reducing Learn-to-do meanings.
Persistent control relation. Physical grabbing is represented as concurrent onset of Touch and Control; broader command/possession/control readings remain distinct by context.

Physical Distance(a,b) returns Length. Contextual boundary-distance overloads return an ordered EvaluationValue measuring nearness to satisfaction of a gradable Property or EventSpec; zero is the boundary, and objective magical use requires an explicit registered metric/threshold model.

For concrete Events, During is temporal containment. For EventSpecs, During(E,T) states that at least one matching occurrence is active across the supplied TimePoint or TimeInterval. For Proposition + TimeInterval, During(P,I) means P holds throughout I.

Relates an Explanation to the proposition it explains. A contextual Proposition+Proposition frame represents ordinary discourse explanation ('target because reason') without collapsing physical Cause or epistemic EvidenceFor.

Persistent deontic/social responsibility for an EventSpec. Optional :context identifies the social, institutional, or interpersonal context/source of the obligation; promise-established commitment is represented with this same relation.

General topological/temporal overlap. For Regions, Overlap means their interiors share nontrivial spatial extent; boundary-only contact is Touch rather than Overlap. The same root also has Entity, Event, and TimeInterval frames.

Permission relation. The agent+EventSpec frame states that an agent is permitted to perform an EventSpec. The EventSpec+:authority frame states that the EventSpec itself is permitted/consented to by the named authority; addressed Say of that proposition expresses consent, while Say of its negation expresses refusal.

Contact relation. Touch(Entity,Entity) is a persistent contact state between entity extents. Touch(Entity,Region) states that the Entity's spatial extent contacts the Region boundary; this typed topological frame is used to distinguish strict Inside from boundary-inclusive In.

General per-time rate. Rate(quantity, interval) returns that quantity's dimension divided by Time; Rate(EventSpec, interval?) returns event occurrence frequency, with omitted interval allowed only contextually.

General sensing process. The explicit channel frame covers raw sensory acquisition. The two-argument Entity frame is contextual shorthand for successful perception plus semantic interpretation when the stimulus is a Sign (the former Read meaning); explicit composition should retain the Sign(stimulus) condition, and channel/language mapping must be supplied or context-resolved as appropriate.

Moves a resource/value from source to destination, optionally with an amount. When the transferred resource is a Distribution, the optional named :profile role constrains its destination distribution profile; this replaces the specialized Redistribute process.
Persistent intended goal/function relation. A Method's goal and an artifact's designed function are both Purpose(subject,goal); temporary Use does not establish Purpose.
Constructs/retrieves the Distribution of a resource/value over a host/domain. It is the general Distribution-valued field constructor used by Density/Transfer semantics.
Returns the aggregate amount of a Distribution over an optional Region/domain. This is conceptually an integral/aggregate operation and is distinct from local Density.

Selects the first member of an ordered Sequence. With an EventSpec, First is contextual shorthand for the next/first matching occurrence after the active temporal reference; this consolidates the former NextOccurrence operator and remains non-objective unless the occurrence domain/reference is independently fixed.

Causal relation between actual Events, or causative EventSpec where an Entity causes an EventSpec or persistent StateProposition to obtain. Optional :instrument records the instrument of the causative episode.
Use(agent,instrument,goal) is the intentional instrument Process. Use(event-or-EventSpec,instrument) is the participant-role relation formerly written Using.
Event/EventSpec beneficiary role. It is distinct from recipient, transfer, possession, and intended Purpose: benefit may be indirect or unintended.
Information-topic relation. Aboutness is semantic topicality and remains distinct from Sign Meaning, Purpose, EvidenceFor, and structural Part.
Sign-to-content interpretation relation. General Meaning may be ambiguous/context/language-sensitive, so it is not reducible to topicality, equality, or evidence.

General extent family. Extent(entity) can return the occupied Region when Region is expected or a contextual ordered holistic size/extent EvaluationValue when an EvaluationValue is expected. Extent(subject,frame,axis) returns projected Length on a CoordinateFrame axis; Extent(Event) returns the Event's temporal extent as Quantity:Time. The two-argument axis shorthand uses a contextual frame. Objective magic should use explicit physical measures/frame where required.
Contextual discourse contrast/concession relation between represented propositions or EventSpecs. It preserves both sides while marking an expectation/tension relation not supplied by plain And.
Contextual resistance to indentation/deformation above the relevant standard.
Contextual edge/point concentration above the relevant standard.
Persistent wakefulness state.
Contextual open-state Property relative to an object's closure/design.
Persistent locked/sealed-by-lock state where the world model supplies the locking relation.
Oral biting Process. Attack, Eat, Touch, and Damage may overlap with particular bites but do not encode the biting manner itself.
Supported/contact locomotion Process relative to a target. It is not merely upward Move; climbing can proceed up, down, across, or over.
Non-agentive/context-governed falling motion. The direction and acceleration come from the applicable physical/world frame rather than from an explicit Move goal or Path.
Contextual jumping locomotion, optionally toward a goal Location. Jumping preserves launch/airborne motion manner that generic Move does not encode.
Directed puncturing/thrust action by an agent against a target, optionally with an instrument. Attack, Damage, Touch, and Use may overlap with a stab but are not equivalent to the stabbing manner.
Locomotion with an asymmetric/impaired gait manner. It does not by itself assert a particular injury, Damage level, or cause.
Ordered degree of physical damage/injury; exact calibration belongs to the world model.
Ordered hunger degree; thresholds such as Hungry remain contextual unless the world model supplies an objective standard.
Ordered perceived/acoustic loudness scale; objective magical use requires the world package to supply a measurement model.
Evasive action intended to avoid a threat. Dodging need not prevent the threatening event itself and is not identical to generic Move or Attempt.
States that an EventSpec occurs as an involuntary/reflex response rather than a consciously chosen action. Absence of intention alone is not equivalent to reflexive execution.

Contextual camouflage relation between a subject and a background, optionally for an observer. ColorOf and TextureOf expose appearance components, but no current general observer-relative perceptual-similarity metric makes them an exact replacement.
Ordinary sex/gender classification property. Exact objective classifier belongs to the world ontology; the root is reusable outside religious vocabulary.
Ordinary intentional/religious act of worship or reverence. The existence or divinity of the object is not entailed by the act alone.
Persistent affectionate/loving orientation toward a target; distinct from Like and from Want.
Persistent strong aversive/hostile attitude toward a target; not simply logical Opposite of Love.
Persistent interpersonal reliance/confidence. Trust in a specific proposition remains Believe/Know.
Persistent positive regard acknowledging worth/status/character; distinct from Like.
Persistent evaluative admiration of a person, action, work, or other semantic target.

Persistent gratitude toward a benefactor; an optional explicit basis/reason can be supplied with :basis. Saying this proposition to the benefactor expresses thanks without entailing sincere gratitude.
Compassion toward another entity's suffering or need.
Jealous attitude toward a target; exact social cause/context may be stated separately.
Fear directed toward an entity, event, proposition, or other semantic target.
Persistent grief/sorrow concerning a person, event, or state of affairs.

Remorse concerning an action, event, or consequence attributed to oneself. The one-argument form leaves the basis contextually supplied for ordinary discourse; objective use should state the basis explicitly. Saying the proposition to an addressee can express an apology without entailing sincerity.
Shame concerning an action, property, event, or social fact.
Ordinary friendship relation; world/social context may define persistence and reciprocity.
Ordinary parent-child relation. Child-of can be expressed by reversing roles.
Persistent marriage/spousal relation; legal/cultural validity belongs to world ontology.
Persistent betrothal/engagement relation, distinct from marriage.
Ownership/property-right relation; exact legal rules belong to world ontology.
Persistent comprehension of information, language, explanation, rule, or other semantic content.
Persistent memory/retention of semantic content; forgetting can be expressed as loss/non-presence of this state.
Attribution of responsibility for an action, event, or state. Causal, legal, and moral grounds can be represented separately.
Ordered social reputation/standing. Without an explicit community or evaluator context, ordinary discourse supplies it.
Act/state transition of relinquishing blame or resentment toward an offender for an offense. It does not erase memory, deny responsibility, require affection, or imply legal pardon.
Persistent/contextual happiness state; degree/intensity can be represented through evaluation/measurement when needed.
Persistent/contextual sadness state.
Persistent/contextual anger state; anger's target/cause can be stated separately.
Tie-preserving minimum selector over a collection using an ordered key expression.
Tie-preserving maximum selector over a collection using an ordered key expression.
General measurement-unit Kind/root used productively in historical Unit names. Specific typed units are Old Names, not separate primitive roots.
Contextual above-relevant-standard predicate over ordered EvaluationValue, Quantity, or Ratio values. Objective magical use should compare against an explicit threshold.
Contextual below-relevant-standard predicate; distinct from Not High because an intermediate band may exist. Objective magical use should compare against an explicit threshold.
